units.source_text: 公共马车里只坐着阿笑一个人。

en.t: Ah Xiao was the only person sitting in the public carriage.

units.source_text: 她用白围巾紧紧围住双颊，

en.t: She had a white scarf wrapped tightly around both cheeks,

units.source_text: 两手揣在怀里，把脸庞埋在长袖里，

en.t: with both hands tucked inside her robe and her face buried in her long sleeves,

units.source_text: 蜷缩在车厢的一个角落里，脑袋深深地耷拉着。

en.t: curled up in one corner of the carriage, her head drooping low.
